_note: Committed template: every setting carries the real SLZUSD values EXCEPT students/roster, which are names and stay local. Run `npm run init-config` to copy this to config.json (gitignored) and enter names there — never put names in this file.

playlist.target: Apologize When You Make a Mistake

_playlistNote: Ordered sequence per student, overriding mode/targetActivity when non-empty. Entries: {"mode":"movie"|"activity","target":"Exact Activity Name"} for one named item, or {"mode":"movie","count":5} for the first 5 in list order (activity entries skip anything at 100%; movies play regardless). "once":true = first student of the session only (content the group watches together). Set "playlist": [] for one activity per student.

teacherLed._note: enCORE Teacher-Led setup, used by afterRotation:"teacherLed" or `npm start -- --teacher-led`. group takes precedence over students. autoBegin:true clicks Begin Session itself — a REAL logged session; false stops at the button. encoreAppHash null = district profile's hash (slzusd: #/apps/encr).

studentLed._note: enCORE Student-Led, one learner per run: `npm start -- --student-led --subject ela|math|science|social-studies|social-skills`. social-studies is the enCORE school subject (Social Studies). social-skills is the separate Social Skills activity — it is not another name for Social Studies. The UI buttons, the para page (school subjects only), and windows/*.cmd pass the subject. `learners` maps pseudonym → display name; learnerPseudonym is the default learner (the CLI, the .cmd launchers, the dashboard buttons). In your local config.json fill each entry with the learner's display name EXACTLY as enCORE shows it — never here in the template. More learners = more entries (Settings → Learners); each gets a tab on the para page (npm run para). defaultSettings lists learners who don't work by subject: their para tab has ONE Student-Led button (--subject default) that picks the learner and leaves the lesson screen exactly as enCORE sets it up. Only the chosen subject stays checked on step 2; the runner stops at READY and you press Next/launch. lessonSource: recommended (app default) | iep | facilitator | benchmark. autoBegin:true also presses Next and the step-3 launch button (unverified screen) — a REAL logged session.

_socialSkillsRoutinesNote: Per-learner Social Skills button on the para page, keyed by the same pseudonym as studentLed.learners: { "<pseudonym>": { "target": "Movie Name", "movieTimes": 5, "thenActivity": true } } logs the learner in (display name from studentLed.learners), watches target movieTimes times, then Does the Activity once (skipped if already at 100%). One pass, then it stops. Fill it in your local config.json or Settings → Learners.
